name: XenForo
description: Connects TroopTracker to a XenForo forum: keeps forum users in step with troopers. More of the forum integration moves here in later releases.
author: Obsidian Slicers

settings.label: Forum URL
settings.help: For example https://forum.example.com. Leave empty to use XENFORO_BASE_URL.

settings.label: Forum name
settings.help: Shown to troopers, for example on the login button. Leave empty to use XENFORO_NAME.

settings.label: API key
settings.help: A XenForo super user API key. Leave empty to use XENFORO_API_KEY.

settings.label: API user ID
settings.help: The forum user the API acts as. Leave empty to use XENFORO_API_USER.

settings.label: Require a linked forum account
settings.help: Troopers must link their forum account to use the site. Until this is saved here, TRACKER_REQUIRE_XENFORO is used.
